title: Step 66-B Content SEO sitemap and public catalog-state contract readiness
description: HIGH-risk Step 66-B. Repair only proven public contract/readiness gaps before Storefront implementation: typed public Article responses, bounded Article/sitemap cursors, a public published-Article sitemap JSON boundary, and explicit safe public reads for previously-published archived products and currently published effective stop-sale products. robots.txt remains Storefront-owned; Contact mutation remains absent; no legal/content rule is invented.

dependencies.evidence: PR #340 merged; exact-SHA Canonical CI 38051125948, Phase A 38051125928 and CodeQL 38051126275 PASS; terminal Lock released.

acceptance_criteria.description: Public Article endpoints expose typed response schemas aligned to current published-only runtime including backend-owned SEO metadata; no draft/scheduled/admin content is exposed.
Article and sitemap cursors are bounded before base64 decoding and contracts advertise runtime-accurate limits and failures.
GET /content/sitemap/articles exposes only published Article loc/lastmod data. robots.txt remains Storefront-owned; no backend robots endpoint is invented.
GET /catalog/archive exposes only archived products with historical published_at and archived_at, minimal public fields, and never archive_reason, stale price, inventory or admin-only state.
GET /catalog/stop-sale exposes only published products whose effective sales authority is false, without conflating inventory-only out-of-stock with stop-sale.
Generated TypeScript is byte-for-byte reproducible from canonical OpenAPI via openapi-typescript 7.13.0.
No database migration, dependency, Storefront, Pricing, Cart/Checkout, Customer, Contact mutation, legal/policy content or Current-State mutation is introduced.
Archive/stop-sale cursors are bounded, opaque, route-scoped and stable by timestamp+id; never-published archived products remain private.

HIGH-risk terminal closure requires exact-head CI, Phase A, CodeQL/Security, deterministic Review, exact-artifact Lock, exact-artifact Project Owner Human approval, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 66-B is HIGH risk. Project Owner Human approval must bind to frozen exact head/artifact only after provider checks, Security, deterministic Review and ACTIVE Lock pass.

evidence.archive_privacy_rule: status=archived AND published_at IS NOT NULL; archive_reason forbidden
evidence.stop_sale_rule: status=published AND effective_sales_enabled=false; inventory-only out-of-stock is not stop-sale
